Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human sodium-dependent noradrenaline transporter (CHEMBL222). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, target_dictionary, compound_records, docs, and compound_structures. Filter by target CHEMBL222, standard_type IC50, and standard_units nM. Require canonical_smiles to be present and require at least one citation (pubmed_id or doi). Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
